svg.aria-label: Simulation of one relative name looked up twice. Standing in first-site, the name index.html is measured from that folder, resolves to a path that exists, and cat prints Ground Zero. After cd dot-dot the identical name is measured from the parent, resolves to a path no file has, and the reply is No such file or directory. The file on disk never moves.
svg.title: Simulation of one relative name looked up twice. Standing in first-site, the name index.html is measured from that folder, resolves to a path that exists, and cat prints Ground Zero. After cd dot-dot the identical name is measured from the parent, resolves to a path no file has, and the reply is No such file or directory. The file on disk never moves.
